capability.title: Discovery, Coverage and Target-Profile Quality
capability.outcome: The pipeline finds relevant Hannover/remote roles with measurable coverage, current profile truth and controlled false-negative analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Promotion and discovery changes have benchmark evidence.
validation: Representative benchmark matrix and scheduler-cycle evidence.

stories.title: DB-Backed Manual Market Observation Reconciliation
stories.outcome: MARKET-003 implementation status is verified and remaining persistence/review gaps are explicit.
acceptance_criteria: Implemented A-F slices are marked correctly.
Remaining DB model/backfill/operator flow is identified.
validation: Repo/DB inspection and targeted MARKET-003 tests.

stories.title: ASSUMPTION-001 Validation Register
stories.outcome: Heuristics carry evidence, confidence, allowed use and expiry instead of becoming silent truth.
acceptance_criteria: Normalization, identity, duplicate, remote, source-family and relevance assumptions are registered.

stories.title: StepStone/Wave Cycle Operational Validation
stories.outcome: Repeated cycles prove novelty rotation, suppression and bounded scheduler behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Cycle metrics show new-company yield, saturation and false suppression.
Scheduler remains disabled until proof passes.
validation: Repeated controlled runs and capability audit.

stories.title: Candidate Promotion Quality Benchmark
stories.outcome: Türsteher false-negative and false-positive behavior is measured before threshold changes.
acceptance_criteria: Representative positive, weak, ambiguous and negative cases.

stories.title: Generic Origin and Detail Evidence Benchmark
stories.outcome: URL/detail recovery works across providers and company shapes rather than selected employers.
acceptance_criteria: Provider, alias, acronym, weak-result, missing-detail and access-risk cases covered.

stories.title: Sensor Contribution and Blind-Spot Audit
stories.outcome: Each sensor's unique value, overlap, cost and missed-market contribution is measurable.
acceptance_criteria: BA remote/nationwide, StepStone and origin sources have contribution metrics.
Stale/duplicate noise is separated from unique discovery.

stories.title: Search-Term Registry for Current Target Profile
stories.outcome: Search terms cover the chosen profile families with signal strength and provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Role families and German/English terms are versioned.
High-travel and irrelevant role families remain malus/exclusion signals.
validation: Search-term contract and discovery dry run.

stories.title: Deterministic Matching Signal Model
stories.outcome: Adjacent Data/AI reliability roles can be recognized without opaque LLM judgement.
acceptance_criteria: Missing evidence and uncertainty are surfaced.
validation: Representative matching fixtures and regression tests.
